name: Miyazu
text: Miyazu (宮津市, Miyazu-shi) is a city located in Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. As of 28 February 2022, the city had an estimated population of 16,988 in 8348 households and a population density of 98 persons per km2. The total area of the city is 172.74 square kilometres (66.70 sq mi).

depictions.name: Miyazu
depictions.text: Miyazu, Kyoto Miyazu (宮津市) is a city in the Kyoto Prefecture, Japan. During the Sengoku period, it was situated in Miyazu Bay in the Tamba province.
